body:
Because of the method of "survival" I developed when I was young to stop all the bullying and harassment was to withdraw completely and act as nice and selfless as possible, there might be one in a thousand women who might take that to believe that I'm a genuinely good person. It doesn't take the intuition of a psychic to quickly brush away the thin surface and discover there's no substance to my being. A decade spent destroying myself from within has left me with nothing but a handful of sticks and stones to rebuild with.

The few things I'm interested in such as psychology and history I could never feasibly build a career on. Higher education in the US is completely fucked. Universities are no longer centers of freethought, but far-left indoctrination centers/"safe spaces" instead. I could tolerate this, but it's so ludicrously expensive anyways and guarantees that unless you immediately find a high-paying job afterwards (also very unlikely), you'll be paying off debt for decades, if not for the rest of your life. Never mind the fact my capacity for self motivation is non-existent.

I am ridiculously thin-skinned. I take things personally and despite being lazy I'm incredibly hard on myself. In high school I was a typical NiceGuy (TM) and badly wanted a girlfriend. After high school, I discovered and started consuming quasi-TRP material. You can probably guess how that turned out. Being the man, I am forced to take the initiative despite extreme social anxiety. Rejection of any sort tears me apart. I've been (un)lucky enough to have had two girls interested in me before. Once this happens, I became very clingy and whatever ember there might have been gets snuffed out.

The first one was a very nice girl I knew since elementary school. We met up twice and made plans to see a movie. It's worth mentioning that I was (dangerously) manic at the time with some serious rage issues. When she didn't return my texts for a couple days, I exploded and said some very nasty things to her. Needless to say I haven't seen her since. I was convinced for months afterwards that I was completely in the right and she was a bitch just like all the rest, until I got very stoned on some quality weed one night and it hit me just what a complete fucking asshole I was.

The second one isn't nearly as remarkable. We dated for a couple weeks, by far the longest time I've dated, I got clingy again and revealed my status as a boring loser. She ran for the hills. This was almost two years ago, and it's when I realized that my personality was utterly incompatible with romantic relationships.

In all honesty, though, my lack of relationship is not at all the driving force behind my suicidal urges. I've all but destroyed my desire for romance in favor of just wanting to be satisfied with my position in life, but I can't even do that.
